parameters.name: LabelIds
parameters.description: A collection of label IDs. A maximum of five IDs can be specified.

parameters.name: NeedRelatedInfo
parameters.description: Specifies whether to query related task information, such as data source connections, transfer instances, and task steps. The default value is true.

parameters.name: Order
parameters.description: The sort order. Valid values are `asc` (ascending) and `descend` (descending). The default value is `descend`.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number for paged queries.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page for paged queries.

parameters.name: SearchKey
parameters.description: The name or ID of the data migration or data synchronization task.

parameters.name: SinkEndpointTypes
parameters.description: A collection of destination data source types.

parameters.name: SortField
parameters.description: The field to sort by. Valid values are `gmtCreate` and `gmtModified`. The default value is `gmtCreate`.

parameters.name: SourceEndpointTypes
parameters.description: A collection of source data source types.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: A collection of task statuses. Valid values include \`INIT\`, \`RUNNING\`, \`SUSPEND\`, \`FAILED\`, \`FINISHED\`, \`RELEASING\`, \`RELEASED\`, \`DELETED\`, \`RUNNING\_MODIFYING\`, \`RUNNING\_MERGING\`, \`RUNNING\_ALARMING\`, and \`UNCONFIGURED\`.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The task type. Valid values are `MIGRATION` for data migration and `SYNC` for data synchronization.
><notice>The Type parameter is required.></notice>
